title: MLB rolls out "robot umps", or an Automated Ball-Strike System, using Sony-made advanced cameras to help officiate games, but it often validates human umpires (Austin Carr/Bloomberg)
summary: Austin Carr / Bloomberg: MLB rolls out “robot umps”, or an Automated Ball-Strike System, using Sony-made advanced cameras to help officiate games, but it often validates human umpires — The automated ball-strike system has often validated the judgement of the human umpires … Tech Across the Globe
